schema_gate: Both FITRES have CID, PKMJDINI, PKMJD, PKMJDERR, SIM_PKMJD, STRETCH, STRETCHERR, AV, AVERR, ERRFLAG_FIT, CUTFLAG_SNANA, SIM_LIBID and common version headers; stop if parsing or uniqueness fails.
grain: Every SN: row in each nominal FITRES, including failed fits; no quality or selection cut. Pair by exact CID only after uniqueness and simulation truth-column agreement checks; preserve unmatched rows.
validity: Numerically finite decimal peak values, with any value <= -8 or >= 999999 treated as a sentinel. Report sentinel and nonnumeric counts by column; retain all original strings. No imputation.
primary_differences_days: optnir PKMJD - nir PKMJD on common valid CID
optnir PKMJDINI - nir PKMJDINI on common valid CID
summaries: For each difference and stratum: n, mean, population SD, median, median absolute deviation, min/max, q01/q05/q95/q99, and counts/fractions |difference| <= 0.01, 0.03, 0.05 days. Preserve decimal text precision and compute differences using Decimal values; mark summaries limited by printed precision.
fixed_error_audit: Report zero, negative, positive, nonfinite and sentinel counts for PKMJDERR, STRETCHERR, AVERR, plus unique printed values when few. Cross-tab with ERRFLAG_FIT. Do not treat zero printed errors as exact model truth without source confirmation.
identity_checks: CID uniqueness each arm; common-CID equality of SIM_PKMJD, SIM_LIBID, SIM_TYPE_INDEX, SIM_STRETCH and SIM_AV at printed precision, with discrepancy rows preserved.
interpretation: The source recipe's 0.01-day GENSIGMA_SEARCH_PEAKMJD is a descriptive reference for initializer-minus-simulation truth only if PKMJDINI is source-confirmed to use SEARCH_PEAKMJD. Do not infer an execution hash chain, full selection, bias, or cosmology. Optical fitted peak is never substituted for simulation truth.
